title: Parameter register record
description: One row of parameters.csv. The authoritative vocabulary lives in scripts/extract_params.py::SCHEMA; this file documents the field contract and the names the checker recognises.

param_id.description: Stable id cited from the chapter as [P0xx].

name.description: Canonical name when the key matched the vocabulary, otherwise the normalised key.

scope.description: Stage the value belongs to. Values are only compared inside one scope.

value_raw.description: Exactly as written in the material, before any numeric parsing.

value_num.description: Parsed number, null when the value is symbolic (adamw, fp16, cifar10-v2).

unit.description: Unit implied by the value or by the vocabulary; empty when dimensionless.

target.description: What the parameter acts on: optimizer, data loader, model, hardware, data split, environment.

source.description: path#Lstart-Lend. A parameter without an address must not appear in the chapter.

all_sources.description: Every address where this name/value was seen.

status.description: conflict means: same name, same scope, different values. It is never resolved by choosing one.

vocabulary.note: Names the extractor recognises. Keys are matched after removing spaces, underscores, hyphens and dots, so image_size, image-size and imageSize are one name.

excluded_by_design.note: These are observed in materials but are not settings, so they never enter the register.
code_references: a bare identifier on the right-hand side, e.g. lr=lr or optimizer=args.opt
any value containing a bracket, because it is an expression
